variants.subject: A cheerful chibi girl with a neat short midnight slate-blue bob, airy side-swept bangs, one simple cobalt hair clip, large clear blue-gray eyes, and a gentle confident closed-mouth smile. The hairstyle is compact and clean, with the ears slightly visible. Friendly and tidy.
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: ONE square production desktop app icon, an original chibi female mascot for a Chinese local work journal app.
Input image 1 is a STYLE, COLOR PALETTE, and FRAMING reference only. Generate a distinct new character option. Do not duplicate the reference girl's exact hair or face.
Subject: A cheerful chibi girl with a neat short midnight slate-blue bob, airy side-swept bangs, one simple cobalt hair clip, large clear blue-gray eyes, and a gentle confident closed-mouth smile. The hairstyle is compact and clean, with the ears slightly visible. Friendly and tidy.
Clothing: a simple cobalt-blue and ivory-white cardigan with a clean collar, similar color balance to the reference. Show only head and shoulders.
Style: polished original anime-inspired chibi illustration with an oversized round head, tiny upper body, clear navy outlines, broad clean shapes, subtle cel shading, softly blushed peach skin and readable expressive facial features. Adult-friendly cute productivity mascot. Keep the finish as polished and clean as the reference.
Composition: square canvas, one centered head-and-shoulders portrait. Head and hair occupy about 80 to 86 percent of the canvas width, with the full hairstyle visible and a small safety margin. Cardigan touches the bottom edge. Big face and eyes that remain recognizable as a 32px desktop icon.
Palette: cool gray, cobalt blue #4263EB, pale blue #EAF0FF, ivory and dark navy-brown tones. OPAQUE continuous pale blue background reaches all four edges and all corners. No transparency and no outside border.
Constraints: exactly one original girl and one complete icon. No writing, no letters, no numbers, no label, no app name, no watermark, no signature, no icon sheet, no phone or desktop mockup, no extra objects, no outer shadows, no decorative background patterns. Avoid intricate tiny hair strands, excessive highlights and glitter, ornate clothing, excessive eyelashes, and clutter. Do not reference an existing anime character.
This is option A, but never draw the option letter in the image.
